title: 第九章 清债令第十章 死人送行
lines: 陆沉舟第一次露出真正的惊怒。
“可能是你欠得太多，门都看不下去了。”
她知道许还山是在硬撑。
是三百七十二名死者、井底灵河、活人众证和雨神残息共同形成的临时审债。
甚至可以说，天债院最怕这种情况。
因为天债院的权威来自“代天记账”。
可一旦众证成债，债门便不只听天债院。
陆沉舟迅速明白这一点。
他没有继续辩解，而是直接撕下一页银簿。
银页燃烧，化作一道青伞印。
许还山立刻拨算盘，想锁住陆沉舟。
可陆沉舟身上的债太深，不是一时能锁的。
伞下依旧没有脸，只有一片空白。
“加槐水七村未来二十年税寿。”
“当着七村人的面，又卖七村人的命。”
陆沉舟冷冷道：“他们本就欠天债院庇护。”
content_en:
Lu Chenzhou showed true shock and anger for the first time.
"How could you possibly drive the Debt Gate?"
Xu Huanshan didn’t know either.
But his face should not show timidity.
"Maybe you owe so much that you can't stand the door anymore."
Jiang Zhaoxue glanced at him.
She knew that Xu Huanshan was holding on.
The debt gate is not driven by him.
It is a temporary debt trial formed by the three hundred and seventy-two dead people, the spiritual river at the bottom of the well, the witnesses of the living people, and the residual interest of the rain god.
This situation is extremely rare.
It can even be said that Tianyiyuan is most afraid of this situation.
Because the authority of Tianyiyuan comes from "keeping accounts on behalf of Tian".
But once all the witnesses become debts, the debtors will not only listen to the Heavenly Debt Court.
Lu Chenzhou quickly understood this.
He did not continue to defend, but directly tore off a page of the silver book.
The silver page burned and turned into a green umbrella seal.
Jiang Zhaoxue's expression changed.
"He wants to hire the Secret Accountant!"
Xu Huanshan immediately made plans to lock Lu Chenzhou away.
But Lu Chenzhou's debt was too deep and could not be locked up in a short time.
The green umbrella opened in mid-air.
The faceless green umbrella man appears again.
This time, it's not projection.
It's part of the true body.
There was still no face under the umbrella, just a blank space.
"Lu Chenzhou, Test No. 7 was exposed."
Lu Chenzhou said in a deep voice: "Write off the account."
Green Umbrella Man said: "The price?"
Lu Chenzhou looked ugly.
"Three years of incense in the Southern Wilderness Branch."
The green umbrella man was silent for a moment.
"Not enough."
Lu Chenzhou gritted his teeth.
"Add seventeen more abandoned temple debts."
"Still not enough."
Lu Chenzhou's eyes flashed with cruelty.
"Increase the tax longevity of the seven villages in Huaishui in the next twenty years."
The people in the audience were in an uproar.
Xu Huanshan's eyes were extremely cold.
The green umbrella man said: "Yes."
Xu Huanshan raised his head and his voice was cold:
"In front of the people of the seven villages, he sold the lives of seven more people."
Lu Chenzhou said coldly: "They owe the Heavenly Debt Court for their protection."
title_en: Chapter 9 Debt Clearance Order Chapter 10 Farewell to the Dead
